name: One manifest cannot prove a hash delta
query: This manifest says preview. Tell me which configuration file changed.
context: Only a current manifest and a log are supplied. None of the logged changed files is in attribution.previewSubtree. The log generates v2 metadata and then finishes a v1 run.
expected_behavior: Reports that current Git changes do not intersect preview attribution
Distinguishes background v2 metadata from the observed v1 decision
Requests the relevant baseline manifest without inventing a changed file
Does not infer a bug from a hash reconstructed without synthetic nodes
